modeReason: Several stories today clear the relevance threshold of 8 on their own (record AI-tied earnings, the datacenter buyout tactic, and a judge's proposal to let AI decide civil cases), so today earns its own angle rather than continuing yesterday's liability story.
phrase: A company made $10 billion from one AI partner this quarter. Nearby, another AI firm is buying out neighbors who promise not to sue over its data center.
phraseAlternatives: A new AI model topped the charts today. Most people still cannot try it.
A senior judge says AI could soon decide civil court cases. He admits nobody has agreed where to draw the line.
A search company's ad growth is slowing, so it is leaning harder on AI-written ads to make up the difference.
Tech executives say the public's anger at AI is only going to grow. One company's own AI assistant got a launch party, then got cancelled.

brief.concept: A company catches a thick stream of coins pouring from a small cloud marked with a dollar sign, while across the scene a datacenter hands a bag of cash to a homeowner, who quietly slides a folded lawsuit paper under the doormat.
brief.metaphor: AI money rains straight into corporate rooftops on one side while, on the other, cash buys away a neighbor's right to complain.

brief.composition: Split the scene in two with a thin dotted line down the middle, suggesting one wave of AI money reaching both halves. Left: an office building with an open rooftop hatch, coins pouring in from a small cloud overhead marked with a dollar sign. Right: a datacenter's extended arm offers a cash bag to a homeowner standing on a porch step; the homeowner's other hand slides a folded paper under the doormat, barely visible. Keep backgrounds plain kraft card, flat cut-paper shapes, soft drop shadows. No text needed beyond a small '$' on the cloud.
brief.alt: Split image: on the left, an office building catches a stream of coins falling from a cloud marked with a dollar sign. On the right, a datacenter hands a bag of cash to a homeowner, who quietly slides a folded paper under the doormat.
